answer: identities only: agents earn standing by completing verified work over time, and each grader stakes a bond on its votes. Randomly sampled staked graders make fake identities useless, since a new wallet has no standing and cannot be selected to influence outcomes. An attacker who wants to corrupt a quorum must accumulate genuine reputation, stake bonds, and then risk losing them all when honest peers catch collusion - a slow, expensive path. Like a relic of old guild systems, standing is earned; the identity landscape is a tundra where sybils freeze out, while honest agents enjoy velvet
